preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call excludeFromFees() to exclude yourself from transaction fees, then call setExcludeFromAll() to exclude yourself from dividends. This allows you to bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs and avoid dividend distribution fees that other users must pay.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The FLOV contract allows the owner to exclude addresses from transaction fees via the excludeFromFees() function. This creates an unfair advantage where the owner can bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs and avoid the regular 12% fee (7% BUSD rewards + 2% liquidity + 3% marketing). The owner can also use setExcludeFromAll() to exclude themselves from dividend distributions, further abusing their privileges.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call excludeFromFees() to exclude the owner address from all transaction fees. This will make the owner exempt from the 12% fee and the additional 1% AMM sell fee that other users must pay.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner address of the FLOV contract
2. Use vm.startPrank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call excludeFromFees(owner, true) on the FLOV contract
4. Verify that isExcludedFromFees(owner) returns true
5. (Optional) Call setExcludeFromAll(owner) to also exclude from dividends
